data_fields.name: molotovThresholds

data_fields.name: pyromaniacFireThresholds
data_fields.donor_constant: mid 1, heavy 1 (player, fire damage type only)

data_fields.name: mapAgesBodies
data_fields.donor_constant: per-map flag 0x02 from world map config key dead_bodies_age

data_fields.name: corpseAgeHours
data_fields.donor_constant: 144 game hours (6 * 24) to blood pools; 336 (14 * 24) for the second stage

data_fields.name: bloodPoolFrameOffsets
data_fields.donor_constant: random 0-3, plus 6 for CRITTER_FLAT, else plus 3 unless rat or mantis

best_idea: A severity variant is chosen from damage and damage type through a base rule table, and the table is overridden per weapon or perk before the rule runs, so a flame weapon or a fire perk changes the thresholds as data rather than as code.
decision_why: Frankendom takes the per-weapon threshold overrides as weapon data applied in a fixed order (base, weapon, perk, divisor) feeding the same tier choice as the Fallout 1 note; no donor code is used (restricted licence) and the server sends the kill with damage, type and weapon tags, so the client never decides the kill.
acceptance: A server-confirmed fire-type kill from a weapon tagged mid 5 and heavy 15 plays the heavy fire clip at damage 15 if the clip exists; a server test asserts the thresholds apply in the order base, weapon, perk, divisor, and that the kill outcome is identical at every client setting.
